sentence: This project studies how changes in the way cells use amino acids affect immune cells that help brain tumors called glioblastomas grow.
This project studies chronic wasting disease in mouse models to track how the disease develops and whether it can pass to humans.
This project builds statistical and machine learning methods to estimate how much each gene affects human traits and diseases.
This project studies what people ask and share about medication for opioid use disorder on Reddit, using natural language processing.
This project tries to find ion channels and transporters in immune cells and find out how they control how those cells develop and work.
This project studies how mitochondria move from astrocytes into glioblastoma cells and how that transfer helps the tumor grow.
This project builds human monoclonal antibodies that bind hantavirus surface proteins and stop the viruses from replicating.
This project supports prostate cancer research by helping with experiment design, genomic sequencing, data analysis and statistical methods.
This project determines the structures of protein complexes in a signaling chain that controls cell growth, to understand how it works in cancers.
This project uses mouse models to study how a protein at the tumor harms a type of T cell that fights cancer, with the aim of helping it survive.
This project builds an injectable hydrogel that mimics lymph nodes, so it can be used to engineer T cells inside the body.
This project tries to find out why inherited mutations cause serious disorders of blood formation and how those diseases progress.
This project studies how circuits linking the cerebellum and the ventral tegmental area affect thinking, reward and fear.
This project runs clinical studies on food allergy, including a treatment for peanut allergy.
This project develops a way to use MRI to find poorly oxygenated tumor regions that resist radiation therapy, and tests it in an Oncopig model.
This project develops methods for DEER spectroscopy, a technique that measures the internal motions of proteins.
This project develops deep learning tools to improve retinal images and use them to screen for preclinical Alzheimer's disease.
This project tries to find out how respiratory metabolism controls the harmful behavior of Staphylococcus aureus bacteria.
This project builds machine learning methods to find drug interaction evidence in scientific papers and turn it into pharmacogenetic ideas to test in a biobank.
This project uses mouse models to study whether maternal obesity raises the risk of colorectal cancer in offspring by changing stem cells.
